title: QE Archive should store structured factor weight percentages for loop analysis
description: Expected: QE Archive stores model factor importance and normalized weight percentage as structured warehouse facts, with run/loop/seed/HMM/strategy/label-horizon/return-risk context and raw artifact pointers. Actual: factor weights in qlib_results_enhanced.json required manual workspace scans, blocking Loop16 factor analysis, cross-seed stability, HMM overlay comparisons, and low-weight factor replacement decisions. The fix extends QE Archive extraction, schema/bootstrap, repository queries, API, and MCP query entry points for factor importance and stability analysis, without storing raw model files as DB blobs.
reproduce_command: Try to query QE Archive for factor weight_pct across qe_20260520_215627_abbc Loop16 and same-config loops; before the fix the structured warehouse query was unavailable and required manual artifact scanning.
required_verification: python -m compileall backend/routers/dispatch.py backend/routers/qe_archive.py backend/routers/qe_templates.py backend/routers/quantevolver.py backend/routers/quantevolver_evolution.py backend/services/dispatch_service.py backend/services/qe_archive backend/services/qe_templates backend/services/quantevolver scripts/aistock_qe_archive_mcp_server.py scripts/aistock_qe_experiment_mcp_server.py scripts/qrun_limit.py scripts/qrun_limit_minute.py
closure_requirements: New QE archive writes extract factor importance and normalized weight_pct from supported enhanced result formats.
qe_archive.run_factor_importance persists weight_pct with DB comments and idempotent migration/bootstrap support.
API and MCP queries return top/bottom factor importance plus seed, HMM/no-HMM, strategy, label-horizon, return-risk, and raw artifact context.
Stability query supports cross-seed aggregation without pretending historical seedless runs are fixed-seed evidence.
Raw model files remain artifact pointers/hashes rather than structured DB blobs.
Production DDL gate applies and verifies qe_archive.run_factor_importance.weight_pct before production runtime activation.
GitHub issue #143 and BUG-100 registry record remain synchronized.
